strings.name: Mira Nair
strings.summary: Nair’s work grew from Indian theater and American documentary training. Salaam Bombay! follows street children; Mississippi Masala and The Namesake explore migration and belonging; Monsoon Wedding joins family comedy with social wounds. Working across Indian, American and East African stories, she also adapts cinema for the stage.
